This '''massage parlor''' was a business that had locations in [[Slum district G17/Legends|slum district G17]] and the [[Lower market districts/Legends|lower market districts]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The one in the slum district was situated next to [[Galaxy Noodles/Legends|Galaxy Noodles]], [[Chezdeze/Legends|Chezdeze]], [[Trueping's/Legends|Trueping's]] and a [[Noodle Bar/Legends|Noodle Bar]] diner. The other parlor was located in a marketplace, near the [[Droid Spa/Legends|Coruscant droid spa]].

The parlor specialized in the treatment of shoulder aches. [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] neon signs, like "massage" and "shoulder aches", were used to attract potential customers.
